scope: Residual P0/P1 wording only; generic Persian fa, Hebrew he using values-iw, Urdu ur.
status: Author candidates and retention decisions; not independent acceptance, production application, native-human certification or full-language completion.
context_limits: Main is the generic section heading adjacent to Drawing/Color, not the separate palette action/state. Current ColourStatusButton.refresh instead composes the separate foreground/background labels. No re-review of the 341-key packets. No application tests or production changes.
encoding: Candidate fields contain display text, not Android outer quote delimiters. Preserve numbered ASCII placeholders exactly and literal U+2026 ellipses. No bidi controls added; consumer-supplied token isolation remains a runtime concern.
